important_scope_decisions: Nancy Ajram: Men Nazra, Aamon Jadidon, Ya Eid and Akher Esdar are mixing and mastering credits; Warana Eh is recording only. A studio-location mention does not establish a personal recording role.
Ramy Ayyach: Ahlan Bil Jamal and Ismallah are mastering credits. Sway is mixing and mastering. Ma Bensak is an owner-confirmed mixing and mastering credit.

Abeer Nehme: Bi Saraha and Aamel Nasini do not acquire mixing/mastering credits from a studio mention; Sleiman Damien holds those published roles. El Meelad El Jayi identifies StudioJPB as the vocal recording studio while Ralph Sleiman receives engineering credits.
Mike Massy/Naseej: the recording note concerns Fadia Tomb El Hage vocal takes at StudioJPB. Mike Massy vocal recording is separately located in France.

Faraj Hanna is credited as a buzuq collaborator on the researched releases; no solo recording project is inferred. Salim Assaf’s Shu Hal Hob and Eza Fik are owner-confirmed recording, mixing and mastering projects.
Sing A Little is labelled 2019 CD edition to match the Philharmonie catalogue; the catalogue date is not treated as the original release date.

Broader search additions preserve studio-only recording attribution for Idi bi Idik and Addaysh Bhebak, and selected vocal recording for Moving Mountains. Maher Zain and Between the two Blacks are excluded at the owner’s request. Beirut the Sea Lover is a live production project for 3D sound mixing, separate from studio release entries.

presentation: At the owner’s request, public entries show artist/project identification and Jean-Pierre Boutros or Studio Jean-Pierre Boutros credits only. Other contributors, research notes, track lists and source-credit labels remain in repository documentation and are not rendered. Related-collaborator roles are not shown.

new_release_links.method: Search results identify official artist/label uploads and streaming release pages. Στα Κόκκινα was inspected in Chrome; Rasha Rizk’s exact Spotify album link was followed from the source album on the published track page and verified as اللعبة by Rasha Rizk.
new_release_links.credit_scope: These links identify the releases. Owner-confirmed roles remain as supplied. The Eza Fik video lists Studio Jean-Pierre Boutros for recording/mixing and a different mastering engineer; its all-stage portfolio role remains based on Jean-Pierre’s direct confirmation. Shu Hal Hob confirms his mix/master credit and a recording location, without naming its recording engineer. The four additional Abeer Nehme roles follow Jean-Pierre’s direct confirmation. Fallou’s official video credits Studio Jean-Pierre Boutros with recording, mixing and mastering. Hikayi’s video names Jean-Pierre for recording and assigns mastering elsewhere; that difference is retained in this private audit. Fi Asfour and Kil Ma T’illi link to the 2019 studio album audio, rather than concert recordings.

date_note: The reviewed date records source research; last_reconciled records alignment with the published release, not a new source retrieval.
